description: Layer 2 of the eval suite: expected verdicts for named complaints in the demo tenant. Data, not code, so the table can be filled in by whoever seeds the tenant and so verify_no_hardcoding.py never finds a demo entity name inside src/. A case whose complaint_id is not present in the tenant is SKIPPED, never passed.

fields.id: stable handle for this case, used as the check id in the report
fields.complaint_id: the complaint document id as it appears in HydraDB, i.e. the value that shows up in LeakVerdict.complaint_ids
fields.expect_work_sources: optional; the set of providers the matched work must come from, e.g. ["linear"]. Omit or leave empty to assert only on the verdict.
fields.note: why this case is here, for whoever reads a skip or a failure

cases.note: Illustrative only. Replace the complaint_id with a seeded complaint that has no matching Linear issue or GitHub item. Until then this case skips.
Illustrative only. Replace the complaint_id with a seeded complaint that was tracked in Linear. Until then this case skips.
